messages.subject: linerange: adjacent bars?
parts:
I'm creating a plot of vertical bars with linerange:
qplot(x=FILT, ymax=SNR,ymin=0,data=SNRm,geom="linerange",group=MET,color=MET,size=I(4)) + facet_grid(S~Jorang)+scale_y_log10()

See the figure in
https://sites.google.com/site/wolfydummysite/home/bars.jpeg.jpg
and the data in
https://sites.google.com/site/wolfydummysite/home/SNRm.rda

I'd like to have the blue and red bars next to each other, instead of one over the other. How could I achieve it?
(Note that in the current plot, in the few cases in which the blue bars are longer than the red bars, the red bar is
hidden by the blue one).

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: linerange: adjacent bars?
parts:
Hello Joan,

Here is one possibility.
qplot(x=FILT, ymax=SNR,ymin=0,data=SNRm,geom="linerange",group=MET,color=MET,size=I(4), position=position_dodge(width=0.7)) + facet_grid(S~Jorang) + scale_y_log10()

And another
p <- ggplot(data = SNRm, aes(x = FILT, y = SNR))
p <- p + geom_linerange(aes(ymin= 0, ymax = SNR, colour = MET), position=position_dodge(width=0.50), size = 3)
p <- p + scale_y_log10()
p <- p + facet_grid(S~Jorang) 
p

HTH, Cheers,
Jonathan
